I do think that it’s up to us at the end to choose how we approach this but under tight time constraints I think there were really not many options. I would suggest that for the next hackathon you consider a different approach: give the participants one single task that’s very creativity based. This way each group can learn and research solving approaches and algorithms and code them using AI and actually learn from the experience
